parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main frame of the refrigerator, made of steel, providing structural support and housing for internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the doors, insulation, and internal compartments, maintaining the refrigerator’s rigidity and durability.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is fixed and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Door (Lower Door)
parts.Basic_description: This is the lower door of the refrigerator, made of steel with insulation inside.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the main cooling compartment and seals tightly to maintain internal temperature.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Door (Upper Door)
parts.Basic_description: This is the upper door of the refrigerator, made of steel with internal insulation.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the freezer compartment and ensures proper sealing to maintain low temperature.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.
